regime_context: The detector shows Oil & Gas Producers (XEG.TO) as a single dominant leader with a wide score margin, high durability (0.72) and broad participation (0.929), while rotation breadth is narrow (44% eligible) and absorption is low (0.3) — a concentrated leadership regime, not a broad tape. Big Banks (ZEB.TO), Technology (XIT.TO), and Consumer Staples (XST.TO) are the other eligible trends with breadth and durability, but none challenges the leader. Track record is mixed (59.8% hit rate but only 0.316 directional accuracy), so conviction must stay low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (XGD.TO) — currently the rotation challenger with the second-highest score (0.672) but NOT trend-gate eligible and with breadth 0.0 — becomes eligible (passes the absolute-trend gate) while broadening its participation beyond a single name. A challenger with no breadth is not yet a handoff; the watch retires if it stays ineligible for 10 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks sits in the trend-gate eligible set with a 'trend' hurst tag (the strongest trend-health signal), above-median durability (0.66), and moderate but non-crowded positioning (z=0.4). Unlike Oil & Gas and Technology, it is not crowded, so a trend-following lean does not carry the reflexivity blow-up risk the guardrails warn about. The trend-gate is the one validated risk-control leg, and Big Banks passes it cleanly.
evidence: crowding_z=0.4 and crowded=false (no sizing caution flag)
theses.dissent: Canadian banks are rate-sensitive and the macro backdrop shows 'inflation' and 'geopolitics' among dominant headlines; a hawkish surprise or credit stress would hit Financials hard regardless of trend health, and breadth is only 0.571 — not a broad-based move.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms XEG.TO by more than 3% over any 10-trading-day stretch before the check-by date

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Staples is trend-gate eligible with high durability (0.74) and very broad participation (breadth 0.923), making it one of the most internally consistent eligible trends. It is not crowded (crowded=false), so the one-narrative dominance in Energy is not spilling into Staples positioning. Qualitatively this reads like a defensive trend with real staying power, a plausible counterweight to the crowded Energy leader.
evidence: durability_bar=0.74 (near the top of the eligible set)
breadth=0.923 (broad participation, not a narrow squeeze)
theses.dissent: Staples has a low absolute score (0.258) and the rank lens has ~zero forward IC — this is a slow, defensive theme, not a leadership candidate. In a strong risk-on rotation it will lag simply because it is not where flow is concentrating.

falsifier.text: XST.TO lags the S&P/TSX benchmark by 4% while the benchmark is positive over the check-by window

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is the dominant leader (rank 1, score 1.585, margin 0.913 over the challenger) with high durability (0.72) and extremely broad participation (breadth 0.929). The trend-gate leg (the one validated edge) is clearly satisfied. However, it is crowded (z=1.2, crowded=true), and the guardrails are explicit: crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade — so the lean is a humble trend-following over-acceptance, not a conviction call. The crowding flag chiefly says 'do not chase with size.'
evidence: rotation.margin=0.913 (wide lead over Gold Miners challenger)
eligible=true and durability_bar=0.72 (trend-gate pass with staying power)
crowded=true with z=1.2 (size-down caution, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Crowding plus a top-of-list attention spike is the classic reflexivity setup the guardrails warn about; ETF inflows into a hot theme have historically marked tops. Energy is also commodity-price driven, and the macro headline mix (geopolitics, inflation) can reverse the oil bid quickly. Trend-gate controls drawdown but offers no return forecast.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO drops more than 5% from its level without a corresponding drop in the S&P/TSX before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
